mapper.sql: payment_id, pay_no, order_id, buyer_id, channel, amount, refunded_amount, status, idempotency_key, paid_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM payment WHERE pay_no = #{payNo} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM payment WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM payment WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, payment_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM payment WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, payment_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( payment_id, pay_no, order_id, buyer_id, channel, amount, refunded_amount, status, idempotency_key, paid_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{payNo}, #{orderId}, #{buyerId}, #{channel}, #{amount}, #{refundedAmount}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{paidAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = 'SUCCESS', paid_at = #{paidAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CLOSED', 'FAILED') AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE payment SET refunded_amount = refunded_amount + #{refundAmount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND refunded_amount + #{refundAmount} <= amount AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE payment SET status = 'REFUNDED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND refunded_amount >= amount AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE payment SET status = 'SUCCESS', updated_at = NOW() WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'REFUNDED' AND refunded_amount < amount AND is_deleted = 0
